cohort_definitions.liquid_empty_warm: m0 IR105 AND all 39 baseline QC levels exactly zero AND baseline model BT minus observed BT > 10 K
cohort_definitions.m0_ir105: baseline fixed-support mask, channel index3/channel ID13 IR105
cohort_definitions.true_optically_empty: all native 39 QC, QI and QS values exactly zero; QI+QS matches direct ice optical mapping; this is distinct from QC-only empty
cohort_definitions.true_optically_empty_warm: m0 IR105 AND all native 39 baseline QC, QI and QS values exactly zero AND baseline model BT minus observed BT > 10 K
cohort_definitions.unfrozen_active_control: m0 IR105 AND any nonzero value in either source-bound restricted z control over 39 levels; frozen block list also retained separately

geometry_and_height.native_order: bottom-first, index1 surface through index39 top

limits: This is one saved native KDM state response at a fixed analysis time; it does not show a new gradient or optimizer relinearization after applying the state change.
The user’s one-shot cloud-analysis effectiveness goal is not met by this evidence; the high-score sample is concentrated and warmed-IR105 / QC-empty cohorts require physical interpretation.
A warm IR105 residual is not cloud truth; no cloud retrieval or independent cloud observation is available here.
RTTOV CFRAC is a bounded binary/near-binary profile diagnostic, not continuous cloud-cover truth.
QC==0 alone does not establish an optically empty column; QI and QS must also be checked. QG and QR are not part of the stated QI+QS direct ice optical mapping.
Column LWP/IWP are per-column physical integrals; cohort summaries are unweighted column statistics, not area-integrated regional mass or a closed precipitation budget.
The candidate is a restricted alpha=1 control endpoint with unchanged original support; no convergence, forecast, host-cycle, time-advance or optimizer-algorithm change is claimed.

native_field_bundles.compression: Lossless NumPy NPZ; binary64 scientific fields are copied without quantization.
native_field_bundles.geometry_note: phi_interfaces and DELZ are included once because baseline/candidate geometry is bitwise identical; DEN*DELZ weights are retained per phase for LWP/IWP reconstruction.
native_field_bundles.source_scope: Split native diagnostics are separate from the historical local optimization/result bundle.

qc_and_phase_transitions.QI_QS_optical_mapping: QI + QS; QG reported separately, QR not folded into mapped ice

baseline.source_formula_scope: Diagnostic replay only; source-built stored profile_CFRAC remains the authority for the optics actually used.

candidate.source_formula_scope: Diagnostic replay only; source-built stored profile_CFRAC remains the authority for the optics actually used.

stored_RTTOV_CFRAC_gate.meaning: Detached binary condensate gate used by the saved optical profile; it is not a continuous cloud-cover analysis or a gradient control.
stored_RTTOV_CFRAC_gate.missing_profiles: Rows with profile_valid false retain NaN/unknown CFRAC, not clear-sky zeros.
stored_RTTOV_CFRAC_gate.source: profile_CFRAC rows from the original baseline/candidate result NPZs, native 39-level segment extracted from stored RTTOV-order profile_CFRAC and reversed to native bottom-first
